question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between Q and R. Only D sits to the right of A. Only one person sits between R and A. B sits at some place to the right of P but at some place to the left of C. How many people sit between C and P?
solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only two people sit between Q and R.
 
• Only D sits to the right of A.
 
• Only one person sits between R and A.
 
• B sits at some place to the right of P but at some place to the left of C
